deities: Maa Vindhyavasini (manifestation of Durga, worshipped as Mahalakshmi in the Trikona Parikrama)

history.dynasty: Ancient; several renovations over centuries (Vindhya Corridor modern project)
history.period: Antiquity uncertain - Puranic origins, mentioned in Markandeya, Skanda and Durga Saptashati texts
history.summary: One of the most revered Shakti Peethas, on the Ganga bank at Vindhyachal, ~8 km from Mirzapur and ~65-70 km from Varanasi. Legend: after Devi Mahamaya escaped Kansa's hands as Yogamaya on Krishna's birth night, she chose the Vindhya hills as her permanent abode (she is 'Yogamaya' and 'Vindhyavasini' - the one who dwells in the Vindhyas); the Devi Mahatmya tradition also credits her with slaying Mahishasura, Raktabeej and Shumbha-Nishumbha. Unlike other Shakti Peethas, no part of Sati's body fell here - the goddess resides by sovereign choice. Folk tradition says the progenitor Manu made the goddess's murti and worshipped her with 100 lotuses. It is the first stop of the Trikon Parikrama (with Kali Khoh ~2 km away and Ashtabhuja ~3 km away). A large-scale Vindhya Corridor redevelopment (Rs 300+ crore, foundation laid 2021) is underway around the temple; the Ashtabhuja-Kali Khoh ropeway (eastern UP's first) was inaugurated the same year. Navratri draws millions; Kajali folk-song competitions are held in Jyestha.

name: Maa Vindhyavasini Devi Temple
town_description: Vindhyachal is a pilgrim town on the Ganga bank in Mirzapur district, eastern Uttar Pradesh, ~8 km west of Mirzapur city and ~70 km from Varanasi. It is one of the 51 Shakti Peethas and the hub of the Trikona Parikrama circuit (Vindhyavasini, Kali Khoh, Ashtabhuja); the Vindhya Corridor project is reshaping its temple precinct.

travel.airport: Lal Bahadur Shastri International Airport, Varanasi (VNS), ~72 km
travel.railway: Vindhyachal railway station, ~1 km (on Delhi-Howrah/Mumbai-Howrah routes); Mirzapur station ~8 km
travel.road: Vindhyachal town on the Mirzapur-Varanasi road; ~65-70 km from Varanasi (~1.5 hr drive); auto-rickshaws/taxis serve the Trikon Parikrama circuit

visitor_information.best_time: October to March; Navratri for grand festivals (millions of pilgrims, very crowded); weekday mornings for calm darshan
